use default

magic(n: int) -> List[List[int]] =>
    (0..n)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..n)
                |> map(column =>
                    let i = row * n + column in
                    let r = row % 4, c = column % 4 in
                    let keep = r == c \/ r + c == 3 in
                    if keep then n * n - i else i + 1 fi)
                |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

column(square: List[List[int]], c: int) -> List[int] =>
    square |> map(row => row[c]) |> collect_list()

check(square: List[List[int]]) -> bool is
    let n = square.count
    let target = n * (n * n + 1) / 2

    let lines =
        square
            |> cat((0..n) |> map(c => column(square, c)))
            |> cat([
                (0..n) |> map(i => square[i][i]) |> collect_list(),
                (0..n) |> map(i => square[i][n - 1 - i]) |> collect_list()
            ])

    lines |> all(line => line |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b) == target)
